hypotheses.reasoning: search-api v3.23.0 started rolling out at 19:12:40 (#92) and was ready at 19:13:18 (#105). The first search-api 500 came 29s later (#109): a TypeError reading 'region' in product-formatter.ts:65, tagged v3.23.0. The same error repeats (#121, #131, #139). There were no 5xx before the deploy. web-bff's 500s (#111 onward) are just passing on search-api's 500s. index-worker kept processing batches normally the whole time, and catalog-db and redis-cache logged no errors, so this doesn't look like a data or dependency problem.

Only some requests fail, which fits a subset of products missing the region field. But nothing points to new bad data at onset. More likely v3.23.0 stopped handling a field that v3.22.7 tolerated being missing.

verdict.recommendedAction: Roll search-api back to v3.22.7. Then fix product-formatter.ts:65 so it handles a missing region (null-safe access or a default), and add tests with products that have no region before redeploying.
